notes: Independent oracle from live Production XP Reward Rules (appn84sqPw03zEbTT) + SC-001 Athlete 1 perfect scenario volumes.
Authoritative challenge window: 2027-04-25 through 2027-06-30 11:59 PM America/Denver inclusive (67 days).
Streak thresholds are LIVE 3/5/7/10/20/30/40/50/60 (9 awards). Offline DEFAULT_STREAK_GATE_THRESHOLDS is stale for XP math.
Within one unbroken 67-day block each streak threshold awards once (053 endDate=block[threshold-1]); Repeatable? applies after a break.
Zoom units follow Production 2026–2027 catalog (1 live attendance + 1 recording makeup). Bonus 2/3 require 2+/3+ qualifying live meetings — not awarded when the season has only one live attendance.
